title: Complete gadget dichotomy for decision-tree depth-to-size lifting

standard_prerequisites.name: Decision-tree depth versus certificate complexity
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Beals et al.2001, exact statement retained in source Corollary3.5 proof.

core_obligations: Characterize non-weakly-resistant gadgets as conjunctions or disjunctions of literals.
Construct blockwise random projections that preserve the outer function while killing leaves with too many certified blocks.
Combine the certificate lower bound and explicit nonlifting families into the full dichotomy.
difficulty_reason: The authors use certificate-conflicting random projections and a union bound over decision-tree leaves, then classify all gadget functions by inclusion-minimal certificates to prove a global lifting dichotomy.

dedup.scope: Actual complete journal DOI and CCC/ECCC identities searched in full legacy/prepared snapshots with zero hit; root also checked both active lines. One depth-to-size classification main theorem counted, not its random projection, resistance or certificate lemmas.
